potential_unspecified_behavior: providers/youtube.py now imports `...service` at module level (providers/youtube.py:57) to get JS_RUNTIME_OPTIONS. This is a new import edge. service.py does not import the subscription package, so no import cycle was found.

JS_RUNTIME_OPTIONS is one module-level dict. `**` spreading copies only the top level, so every YoutubeDL instance, including concurrent ones, gets the same inner `{'node': {}}` object. This is harmless only if yt-dlp never mutates params['js_runtimes'] in place. Not verified against the yt-dlp source.
regression_risks: The backend build now fails on any addon pip or install.sh failure, including cloud-sync's apt-get for rclone. A slow IPv4 path to PyPI or Debian now blocks rebuilds where it used to produce a degraded image. The spec accepts this.

yt-dlp[default] in the backend image adds requests, urllib3, brotli, mutagen, pycryptodomex and yt-dlp-ejs, with floors on websockets and certifi. If core's pins ever fall below those floors, pip could move shared libraries. Not checked against backend/requirements.txt pins.
test_coverage: I8 harness, mutations reasoned through: dropping `|| exit 1` from the pip loop is caught by `requirements-fails-before-one-that-succeeds` because 'pip b_later' runs. Reverting to `; done; true` is caught by every failure case. Dropping `|| exit 1` from the install.sh loop is caught by `install-sh-fails-before-one-that-succeeds`.
